name: Should I move out during a major interior renovation?

mainEntity.name: Should I move out during a major interior renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether to move out during a major interior renovation depends on the project's scope and your personal comfort with disruption. If the renovation involves significant dust, noise, utility shut-offs (like water or electricity for extended periods), or affects essential living areas like the kitchen or only bathroom, moving out might be advisable. For less intrusive projects, living on-site with temporary accommodations may be feasible.
acceptedAnswer.description: Moving out during a major renovation is advisable if it involves significant dust, noise, or utility disruptions to essential living areas.
